newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen hitting record high on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen hitting record high on Tuesday.

text.p: Danish share prices opened unchanged but were expected to set record highs on Tuesday, with Monday's 0.9 percent gain boosted further by overnight highs on the Dow and Standard & Poor's.
"It can go virtually only one day today and that's up. The banks, Novo Nordisk and A.P. Moeller all look attractive," a dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index opened at Monday's closing 161.11.
